answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 19243 Country: India Title: I am self employed,married & having a boy kid. My date of birth is 05.12.1974. Since years, i am observing that the CAT(billi) cross my road very frequently, aprrox 2-3 times a week. Most of the times from Right to Left & some times from Left to Right. When I was a teenager, that time I use to feared about the same. Now its usual for me. But still wherever the Cat cross me, I recite Darut Shareef. Please tell me what should I have to read in such situation. And why this is happening with me?? Question: Assalaam Alaikum, I am self employed,married & having a boy kid. My date of birth is 05.12.1974. Since years, i am observing that the CAT(billi) cross my road very frequently, aprrox 2-3 times a week. Most of the times from Right to Left & some times from Left to Right. When I was a teenager, that time I use to feared about the same. Now its usual for me. But still wherever the Cat cross me, I recite Darut Shareef. Please tell me what should I have to read in such situation. And why this is happening with me?? Answer ID: 19243 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 174/152/D=1431) This is ignorant pessimism and evil omen which has no reality. One should submit his trust in Allah alone. Such thoughts were forbidden in Hadith; rather you should recite this dua at such occasions: اللھم لا یاتی بالحسنات الا انت ولا یدفع السیئات الا انت ولا حول ولا قوۃ الا باللہ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
